articles.title: Crude oil prices rise 10% this week but China enters fray to push for end to Iran war. What’s next?
articles.description: Crude oil futures experienced a significant decline on Friday. This drop followed reports of China's initiative to restart stalled US-Iran peace negotiations. Experts warn of potential price surges if shipping disruptions persist in key waterways.

articles.title: European shares gain as SAP lifts tech stocks; Middle East on watch

Policymakers indicated potential interest rate hikes amid inflation risks.

articles.title: Stocks waver on Wall Street while crude oil prices fall for the first time in a week
articles.description: Stocks saw a mixed close on Wall Street as oil prices declined after a week of gains. Major indexes experienced losses for the week due to escalating U.S. conflict with Iran. Investors also faced new tariffs and persistent inflation concerns impacting the economy. Bond yields eased, providing some relief to the stock market's pressure. European markets advanced while Asian markets closed lower on Friday.
